purpose: Source-backed review reminders for original visible clauses, not extra author requirements. Withheld from timed authors; identical criteria for B/P and first/final. Natural-language/card/view coverage counts; no literal wording, role counts or excluded-scope details required.

p-retry.check: Distinguish pre-callback exhausted time: onFailedAttempt still runs with retryDelay 0, before rejection; consume/retry hooks skipped. Normal remaining-time path calls consume then onFailedAttempt.
shouldRetry follows time/retries/non-network-TypeError guards; no-consume retry still requires time and retries left, skips wait and consumed increment.
AbortError unwraps; AbortSignal checks/cancels timer but does not itself interrupt already-awaited input.
Retry timer bounded by maxTimeout and remaining maxRetryTime; budget does not impose running-input timeout.

quick-lru.check: set distinguishes present in CURRENT map from absent in CURRENT map, which can still be present in OLD. Threshold rotates whole generations, emitting prior old entries.
Current and old lookup differ; live old get promotes by removing old and calling #set. Missing/expired does not return a live value.
has and peek inspect either map without get-style promotion; preserve expiry effects.
Configured onEviction for expiry/rotation, no callback invented for explicit delete/clear; both maps affected, current count decremented only if current deletion succeeded, clear resets count.

perceptual: Inspect actual eligible 1440x900 and 2048x1320 light/dark images. Machine 6px threshold is not by itself perceptual acceptance; assess text and path readability without requiring a new numerical threshold. Normal page-level scrolling is allowed. Missing captures is unknown. Preserve disagreement and root adjudication.
